description: The sounds the previews play, by name: a two-bar groove to put an effect on (drums with ghost notes and a lilt, a bass, an electric piano and plucked notes), a dark, sparse half-time trap hip-hop scene (a clap on the third beat, rolling hats, an 808 driven over a clean sub, a haunting piano in F minor, ambient bells and a pad), a kick, a held chord, a voice with an s, wide chords, pink noise and pulses. Drawn once from the drum voices of the library and looped as a buffer.
name: demo-sound
